c2-chain.title: Four-Clause Fluency
c2-chain.pattern: الفعل + لأن + سبب + بس/و + نتيجة + و + تفصيل إضافي
c2-chain.explanation: This is the top of the course: sentences that pack four full clauses together the way a fluent speaker actually talks -- a statement, its reason, a contrast or addition, and one more detail, all in a single breath: لازم أروح البيت الحين لأن تعبان كثير، بس أبغى أشرب قهوة زين، وبعدين أشرب مويه (I have to go home now because I'm very tired, but I want to drink good coffee, and then I'll drink water). Nothing here is new grammar -- it's the same simple pieces from the whole course, just chained at native speed.
c2-chain.fact: Reaching this level means you can follow (and produce) Gulf Arabic the way it's actually spoken in a real conversation -- not textbook sentences, but the long, looping, reason-then-detail style that native speakers use without even thinking about it.

items.en: I want the red house today because it's very much to the right here, and it's very close today, but the price is very expensive
items.translit: abgha el-bayt el-a7mar el-yoom li-ann yameen hina katheer, wa gareeb zayn el-yoom, bas es-si3ir ghaali katheer

items.ar: تبغى البيت الأزرق اليوم لأن يسار هنا كثير، بس السعر غالي كثير، وعندك فلوس زين اليوم
items.en: You want the blue house today because it's very much to the left here, but the price is very expensive, and you have good money today
items.translit: tabgha el-bayt el-azrag el-yoom li-ann yasaar hina katheer, bas es-si3ir ghaali katheer, wa aandik fluus zayn el-yoom

items.ar: يبغى البيت الأصفر اليوم لأن قدّام المطعم، وعنده فلوس زين اليوم، بس البيت بعيد كثير
items.en: He wants the yellow house today because it's in front of the restaurant, and he has good money today, but the house is very far
items.translit: yabgha el-bayt el-asfar el-yoom li-ann guddaam el-mat3am, wa aandah fluus zayn el-yoom, bas el-bayt ba3eed katheer

items.ar: نروح البيت الأخضر اليوم لأن ورا المستشفى، وعندنا أهل زين هناك، بس السيارة مشكلة اليوم
items.en: We're going to the green house today because it's behind the hospital, and we have good family there, but the car is a problem today
items.translit: nruu7 el-bayt el-akhdar el-yoom li-ann wara el-mustashfa, wa aandana ahl zayn hinaak, bas es-sayyaara mushkila el-yoom

items.ar: رحت المطعم أمس مع صديقي لأن جوعان كثير، وشربت قهوة زين معاه، بس عندي شغل اليوم
items.en: I went to the restaurant yesterday with my friend because I was very hungry, and I drank good coffee with him, but I have work today
items.translit: riHt el-mat3am ams ma3a sadeeqi li-ann jaw3aan katheer, wa shirabt gahwa zayn ma3aah, bas aandi shughul el-yoom

items.ar: رحتي بيت أختك أمس لأن تعبانة كثير، وشربتي شاي زين معاها، بس عندك شغل اليوم
items.en: You (f) went to your sister's house yesterday because she was very tired, and you drank good tea with her, but you have work today
items.translit: riHti bayt ukhtik ams li-ann ta3baana katheer, wa shirabti shaay zayn ma3aaha, bas aandik shughul el-yoom

items.ar: راح المستشفى أمس لأن مريض كثير، وشافه دكتور زين هناك اليوم، بس تعبان كثير الحين
items.en: He went to the hospital yesterday because he was very sick, and a good doctor saw him there today, but he's very tired now
items.translit: raaH el-mustashfa ams li-ann mareedh katheer, wa shaafah doktoor zayn hinaak el-yoom, bas ta3baan katheer el-heen

items.ar: رحنا بيت أهلنا أمس لأن ما شفناهم كثير، وشفنا صديقهم الزين هناك، بس مستعجلين كثير اليوم
items.en: We went to our family's house yesterday because we hadn't seen them much, and we saw their good friend there, but we're very urgent today
items.translit: ru7na bayt ahalna ams li-ann ma shifnaahum katheer, wa shifna sadeeghum ez-zayn hinaak, bas musta3jileen katheer el-yoom

items.ar: عندي فلوس كثير اليوم لأن ما رحت المطعم الغالي، وأبغى أروح المطعم الرخيص، بس عندي شغل الحين
items.en: I have a lot of money today because I didn't go to the expensive restaurant, and I want to go to the cheap one, but I have work now
items.translit: aandi fluus katheer el-yoom li-ann ma riHt el-mat3am el-ghaali, wa abgha aruu7 el-mat3am er-rikhees, bas aandi shughul el-heen

items.ar: ما عندك فلوس كثير اليوم لأن رحتي المطعم الغالي أمس، بس بكرا زين، وعندك شغل بعدين
items.en: You (f) don't have a lot of money today because you went to the expensive restaurant yesterday, but tomorrow it's fine, and you have work later
items.translit: ma aandik fluus katheer el-yoom li-ann riHti el-mat3am el-ghaali ams, bas bukra zayn, wa aandik shughul ba3dayn

items.ar: عنده فلوس زين اليوم لأن ما يروح المطعم الغالي، وأبغى أشرب معاه بكرا، بس السيارة مشكلة
items.en: He has good money today because he doesn't go to the expensive restaurant, and I want to drink with him tomorrow, but the car is a problem

items.en: We have good money today because we didn't go to the expensive restaurant, and we're going tomorrow, okay, today, but we're very urgent
items.translit: aandana fluus zayn el-yoom li-ann ma ru7na el-mat3am el-ghaali, wa nruu7 bukra zayn el-yoom, bas musta3jileen katheer

items.ar: أنا مبسوط اليوم لأن شفت أهلي أمس، وأبغى أروح بيتهم بكرا زين، بس عندي شغل الحين
items.en: I'm happy today because I saw my family yesterday, and I want to go to their house tomorrow, good, but I have work now
items.translit: ana mabsoot el-yoom li-ann shift ahli ams, wa abgha aruu7 baythum bukra zayn, bas aandi shughul el-heen

items.ar: هي زعلانة اليوم لأن ما عندها فلوس كثير، بس صديقها زين معاها، وتبغى تروح بيته بكرا
items.en: She's upset today because she doesn't have a lot of money, but her friend is good with her, and she wants to go to his house tomorrow
items.translit: hiya za3laana el-yoom li-ann ma aandaha fluus katheer, bas sadeegtha zayn ma3aaha, wa tabgha truu7 baytah bukra

items.ar: هو تعبان اليوم لأن رحت الشغل كثير، وأبغى أشرب قهوة معاه بعدين، بس السيارة مشكلة اليوم
items.en: He's tired today because he went to work a lot, and I want to drink coffee with him later, but the car is a problem today
items.translit: huwa ta3baan el-yoom li-ann riHt esh-shughul katheer, wa abgha ashrab gahwa ma3aah ba3dayn, bas es-sayyaara mushkila el-yoom

items.ar: احنا مبسوطين اليوم لأن شفنا أهلنا أمس، ونروح بيتهم بكرا زين اليوم، بس مشغولين كثير الحين

items.en: I'm very stressed today because I have a lot of work at the restaurant, and I'm very tired, but I have to go to work

items.en: I'm very upset now because I didn't go to my uncle's house yesterday, and he has good money there, but they're very busy

items.en: My uncle is very stressed today because he has a lot of work at the hospital, and he's very tired, but he has to go

items.ar: جدي متضايق كثير الحين لأن ما شاف أهله أمس، وعنده بيت كبير هناك، بس بعيد كثير
items.en: My grandfather is very upset now because he didn't see his family yesterday, and he has a big house there, but it's very far
